flags.title: Hotspawn filter counts do not match the listed slate
flags.detail: At 22:04-22:08 UTC on 2026-10-13 the /cs2-pickems page header says "68 matches this week" while its own tournament filter says "All tiers (89)" and /lobby says "All tiers (90)"; only 30 CS2 fixtures carry a live "Locks in" countdown. The remaining ~59 rows are stale 2026-06-26..2026-07-10 fixtures that Hotspawn still reports as "scheduled". This board lists the 30 actionable fixtures.

flags.title: /lobby and /cs2-pickems render times in different time zones
flags.detail: The same fixture is shown as "Oct 14, 04:00" on /lobby and "Oct 14, 08:00" on /cs2-pickems, while both pages show the identical "Locks in 09:55:xx" countdown. The countdown arithmetic (22:04:51 UTC + 9h55m = 08:00 UTC) shows /cs2-pickems renders UTC and /lobby renders UTC-4. This board publishes the countdown-derived UTC time; EGamersWorld independently shows the same kickoffs (UTC+2 display).

flags.fixture: Legacy vs PARIVISION (and every row using the 2026-10-05 standings)
flags.title: The Valve standings snapshot predates a confirmed PARIVISION roster change
flags.detail: Valve's official file standings_global_2026_10_05.md lists PARIVISION at #36 (1411 points) with the roster FL1T, Jame, slaxejezzz, xiELO, zweih. HLTV's team page shows the current roster as HObbit, FL1T, Jame, xiELO, zweih and records that "after HObbit joined and slaxejezzz was benched on Sep 17" the team's results changed. HLTV's own VRS widget puts PARIVISION at #11, not #36, and Legacy at #6 rather than Valve's #2. The rating we publish is the one Valve's official file states; the roster caveat is published here instead of being silently corrected.
